# Get all car rental companies in Paris

# Get the price per day for all car rental companies
car_prices = get_car_price_per_day(all_car_rentals.split(", "))

# Filter car rental companies with prices under 50 euros
affordable_car_rentals = []
for company in all_car_rentals.split(", "):
    if car_prices[company] < 50:

# Get the rating and reviews for the filtered car rental companies

# Find the car rental company with the best rating and reviews
best_car_rental = max(affordable_car_rentals_rating_reviews, key=affordable_car_rentals_rating_reviews.get)

print("The recommended restaurant is:", best_restaurant)
print("The recommended car rental company is:", best_car_rental)
